name: Shadow Strike
benefit:
You can deal precision damage, such as sneak attack damage, against targets with concealment (but not total concealment).
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 131
You can spend 5 stamina points when you hit a creature with total concealment to deal precision damage to that creature.
flavor: You accurately strike even those you cannot clearly see.
